TaskDescription: Dataset C, lower-limb condition: closed-loop task simulating closed-loop operation of a lower-limb rehabilitation BCI with sham feedback (mirror animation), performed with the dominant lower limb only. A 1,000 Hz, 100 ms beep cued movement onset. Movement cues lasted 2.5 s (empirically measured inter-marker interval: 2.64 +/- 0.10 s, n=900 trials across the release). After the first (fixed, ~3 s) rest cue of each run, steady-state rest intervals (rest-cue onset to next movement-cue onset) measured 10.45 +/- 0.30 s (range 9.89-10.98 s, n=810), consistent with the mirror animation shown after each movement cue (119 frames at 24 frames/s, 4.96 s; see stimuli/), after which the programmed 5-6 s random rest elapses.
Instructions: Perform a brief foot movement with your dominant leg when cued and observe the mirrored animation feedback; rest otherwise.
